questions.question: Use calculate_conversion_rate with node_name equal to Referral and use filter_flow with min_value equal to 100.0 in order to know Which acquisition channel demonstrates the most effective user engagement and retention journey, and what factors contribute to its success?

answer.value: Referral channel demonstrates the most effective user engagement with 60% high-activity rate in Month 1 (240/400 users), the lowest early churn at only 7.5% inactive in M1 (30/400), and strong conversion to upgraded plans. This success stems from pre-qualified leads who already trust the product through word-of-mouth, resulting in higher initial engagement and better long-term retention compared to paid channels like Google Ads (32.7% high-activity, 20% inactive) or Social Media (23.3% high-activity, 30% inactive).

key_insights: Referral has lowest early churn at 7.5%
Organic also performs well with 51.7% high-activity
Social Media has highest early churn at 30%

reasoning.reasoning: Calculate conversion rate for Referral channel to understand its effectiveness
Filter flows to see which channels contribute most to high-engagement users
